valtype.name: numtype
valtype.description: A value type that can be a number type, vector type, or reference type.

numtype.name: value
numtype.description: A single byte that determines the type of the numtype. Can be one of four possible types: 'i32', 'i64', 'f32', and 'f64'

vectype.name: vectype_byte
vectype.description: The byte representation of the vectype, which is fixed at 0x7B, corresponding to the vector type v128.

reftype.name: reftype_variant
reftype.description: A single byte that can be either funcref or externref, representing different types of references.

limits.name: limits_variant
limits.description: The limits can be one of two variants. The first variant 'limits_without_max' represents a limit with only a minimum value. The second variant 'limits_with_max' represents a limit with both minimum and maximum values.

limits_without_max.name: flag
limits_without_max.description: A flag indicating that there is no maximum limit. The flag is fixed at 0x00.

limits_with_max.name: flag
limits_with_max.description: A flag indicating that there is a maximum limit. The flag is fixed at 0x01.

global_section.name: section_id
global_section.description: The ID of the global section, which is fixed at 0x06.

global_section.name: globals
global_section.description: A vector of global variables that represent the globals component of a module.

global.name: gt
global.description: The type and mutability of the global variable.

global.name: e
global.description: The initial value of the global variable.

start_section.name: section_id
start_section.description: The ID of the start section, which is fixed at 0x08.

start_section.name: start_function
start_section.description: An optional start function that represents the start component of a module.

start.name: funcidx
start.description: A function index that is used to reference the function in the module.

tabletype.name: et
tabletype.description: The element reference type of the table.

function_section.name: section_id
function_section.description: The ID of the function section, which is fixed at 0x03.

function_section.name: section_content
function_section.description: A vector of type indices that represent the type fields of the functions in the funcs component of a module.

ref.null t.name: opcode
ref.null t.description: The opcode for the 'ref.null t' instruction, which is fixed at 0xD0.

ref.null t.name: t
ref.null t.description: The reference type for the null reference.

ref.is_null.name: opcode
ref.is_null.description: The opcode for the 'ref.is_null' instruction, which is fixed at 0xD1.

ref.func x.name: opcode
ref.func x.description: The opcode for the 'ref.func x' instruction, which is fixed at 0xD2.

ref.func x.name: x
ref.func x.description: The function index for the function reference.

funcidx.name: index
funcidx.description: A u32 value that represents the index of a function in the function indices space of a WebAssembly module.

typesec.name: section_id
typesec.description: The ID of the type section, which is fixed at 0x01.

typesec.name: ft*
typesec.description: A vector of function types that represent the types component of a module.

functype.name: prefix
functype.description: A function type, identified by the byte 0x60.

functype.name: param
functype.description: A vector of value types that represent the parameter types of the function.

functype.name: result
functype.description: A vector of value types that represent the return types of the function.

memidx.name: memidx
memidx.description: A memory index, used to reference a specific memory instance in the WebAssembly module.

memarg.name: align
memarg.description: An alignment hint for the memory operation.

memarg.name: offset
memarg.description: An offset for the memory operation.

tablesec.name: section_id
tablesec.description: The ID of the table section, which is fixed at 0x04.

tablesec.name: tables
tablesec.description: A vector of tables that represent the tables component of a module.

code_section.name: section_id
code_section.description: The ID of the code section, which is fixed at 0xA.

code_section.name: code_entries
code_section.description: A vector of code entries, each of which is a pair of value type vectors and expressions.

Func.name: size
Func.description: The size of the function code in bytes.

Func.name: function_code
Func.description: The actual function code, which consists of the declaration of locals and the function body as an expression.

func.name: expression
func.description: The function body as an expression.

locals.name: count
locals.description: The count of locals of the same value type.

locals.name: value_type
locals.description: The value type of the locals.

element_section.name: section_id
element_section.description: The ID of the element section, which is fixed at 0x09.

element_section.name: element_segments
element_section.description: A vector of element segments that represent the elems component of a module.

element_segment.name: element_segment
element_segment.description: A union of passive element segment and active element segment.

active_elem_seg0.name: prefix
active_elem_seg0.description: An integer indicating the variant of the element segment. It can be interpreted as a bitfield.

active_elem_seg0.name: offset
active_elem_seg0.description: An expression used in some variants of the element segment.

active_elem_seg0.name: funcidxs
active_elem_seg0.description: A vector of function indices used in some variants of the element segment.

passive_elem_seg0.name: prefix
passive_elem_seg0.description: An integer indicating the variant of the element segment. It can be interpreted as a bitfield.

passive_elem_seg0.name: elemkind
passive_elem_seg0.description: An expression used in some variants of the element segment.

passive_elem_seg0.name: funcidxs
passive_elem_seg0.description: A vector of function indices used in some variants of the element segment.

active_elem_seg1.name: prefix
active_elem_seg1.description: An integer indicating the variant of the element segment. It can be interpreted as a bitfield.

active_elem_seg1.name: offset
active_elem_seg1.description: An expression used in some variants of the element segment.

active_elem_seg1.name: funcidxs
active_elem_seg1.description: A vector of function indices used in some variants of the element segment.

declarative_elem_seg0.name: prefix
declarative_elem_seg0.description: An integer indicating the variant of the element segment. It can be interpreted as a bitfield.

declarative_elem_seg0.name: elemkind
declarative_elem_seg0.description: An expression used in some variants of the element segment.

declarative_elem_seg0.name: funcidxs
declarative_elem_seg0.description: A vector of function indices used in some variants of the element segment.

active_elem_seg2.name: prefix
active_elem_seg2.description: An integer indicating the variant of the element segment. It can be interpreted as a bitfield.

active_elem_seg2.name: offset
active_elem_seg2.description: An expression used in some variants of the element segment.

active_elem_seg2.name: exprs
active_elem_seg2.description: A vector of function indices used in some variants of the element segment.

passive_elem_seg1.name: prefix
passive_elem_seg1.description: An integer indicating the variant of the element segment. It can be interpreted as a bitfield.

passive_elem_seg1.name: elemkind
passive_elem_seg1.description: An expression used in some variants of the element segment.

passive_elem_seg1.name: exprs
passive_elem_seg1.description: A vector of function indices used in some variants of the element segment.

active_elem_seg3.name: prefix
active_elem_seg3.description: An integer indicating the variant of the element segment. It can be interpreted as a bitfield.

active_elem_seg3.name: offset
active_elem_seg3.description: An expression used in some variants of the element segment.

active_elem_seg3.name: exprs
active_elem_seg3.description: A vector of function indices used in some variants of the element segment.

declarative_elem_seg1.name: prefix
declarative_elem_seg1.description: An integer indicating the variant of the element segment. It can be interpreted as a bitfield.

declarative_elem_seg1.name: elemkind
declarative_elem_seg1.description: An expression used in some variants of the element segment.

declarative_elem_seg1.name: exprs
declarative_elem_seg1.description: A vector of function indices used in some variants of the element segment.

elemkind.name: kind
elemkind.description: The kind of the element, which is fixed at 0x00 and represents funcref.

memtype.name: lim
memtype.description: The limits of the memory type.

typeidx.name: index
typeidx.description: A variable-length integer that references a type in the type section of a WebAssembly module.

import_section.name: section_id
import_section.description: The ID of the import section, which is fixed at 0x02.

import_section.name: imports
import_section.description: A vector of imports that represent the imports component of a module.

import.name: module
import.description: The name of the module from which the import is made.

import.name: desc
import.description: The description of the import, which can be a function, table, memory, or global.

func_importdesc.name: func
func_importdesc.description: A function import, identified by the byte 0x00.

func_importdesc.name: typeidx
func_importdesc.description: The type index of the function import.

table_importdesc.name: table
table_importdesc.description: A table import, identified by the byte 0x01.

table_importdesc.name: tabletype
table_importdesc.description: The table type of the table import.

mem_importdesc.name: mem
mem_importdesc.description: A memory import, identified by the byte 0x02.

mem_importdesc.name: memtype
mem_importdesc.description: The memory type of the memory import.

global_importdesc.name: global
global_importdesc.description: A global import, identified by the byte 0x03.

global_importdesc.name: globaltype
global_importdesc.description: The global type of the global import.

data_count_section.name: section_id
data_count_section.description: The ID of the data count section, which is fixed at 0x0C.

data_count_section.name: section_len
data_count_section.description: The length of the data count section in bytes.

data_count_section.name: n
data_count_section.description: An optional u32 value representing the number of data segments in the data section. If present, it must match the length of the data segment vector; otherwise, the module is malformed.

expr.name: instructions
expr.description: A sequence of instructions, each represented by 'instr'.

expr.name: end
expr.description: An explicit end opcode, represented by the hexadecimal value '0x0B', that terminates the sequence of instructions.

memory_section.name: section_id
memory_section.description: The ID of the memory section, which is fixed at 0x05.

memory_section.name: memories
memory_section.description: A vector of memories that represent the memory component of a module.

export_section.name: section_id
export_section.description: The ID of the export section, which is fixed at 0x07.

export_section.name: exports
export_section.description: A vector of exports that represent the exports component of a module.

export.name: desc
export.description: The description of the export, which can be a function index, a table index, a memory index, or a global index.

func_exportdesc.name: prefix
func_exportdesc.description: A function export, identified by the byte 0x00.

func_exportdesc.name: desc
func_exportdesc.description: The function index of the export.

table_exportdesc.name: prefix
table_exportdesc.description: The table index of the export.

table_exportdesc.name: desc
table_exportdesc.description: The table index of the export.

mem_exportdesc.name: desc
mem_exportdesc.description: The memory index of the export.

global_exportdesc.name: desc
global_exportdesc.description: The global index of the export.

tableidx.name: index
tableidx.description: A variable-length integer that refers to a table in the table section of a module. It is encoded using the unsigned LEB128 format.

data_section.name: section_id
data_section.description: The ID of the data section, which is fixed at 0x0B.

data_section.name: data_segments
data_section.description: A vector of data segments that represent the datas component of a module.

data.name: variant
data.description: An integer indicating the variant of the data segment. 'active_memory_zero' for active with memory index 0, 'passive' for passive, 'active_memory_index' for active with a memory index.

active_memory_zero.name: flag
active_memory_zero.description: A flag indicating this is an active data segment with memory index 0.

active_memory_zero.name: bytes
active_memory_zero.description: A vector of bytes representing the data segment.

passive_def.name: flag
passive_def.description: A flag indicating this is a passive data segment.

passive_def.name: bytes
passive_def.description: A vector of bytes representing the data segment.

active_memory_index.name: flag
active_memory_index.description: A flag indicating this is an active data segment with a memory index.

active_memory_index.name: bytes
active_memory_index.description: A vector of bytes representing the data segment.

custom_section.name: section_id
custom_section.description: The ID of the custom section, which is fixed at 0.

custom_section.name: custom
custom_section.description: The custom data contained in the section.

custom.name: name
custom.description: A UTF-8 string that further identifies the custom section.

custom.name: bytes
custom.description: An uninterpreted sequence of bytes for custom use.

globaltype.name: val_type
globaltype.description: The type of the global variable.

globaltype.name: mut
globaltype.description: The mutability of the global variable, indicating whether it is constant or variable.
